key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to refresh usage data in seconds

key.name: display-mode
key.description: How to display usage in the panel: 'ring' for a circular gauge and percentage, 'ring-only' for a circular gauge without text, 'text' for percentage text, 'bar' for a progress bar, or 'both' for bar and percentage

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Which usage window the panel reflects: 'largest' for the window with the biggest allowance, 'max' for the most used window, 'primary' for the first window, or 'secondary' for the second window

key.name: usage-display
key.description: Whether to display used or remaining percentages

key.name: icon-style
key.description: Icon style: 'color' for the original colored icon, 'monochrome' for a desaturated monochrome icon

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the provider icon in the top bar

key.name: show-additional-limits
key.description: Whether to show model-specific rate limits (e.g. GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark) in the menu

key.name: proxy-url
key.description: HTTP proxy URL (e.g., http://localhost:11809). Leave empty to use no proxy.

key.name: provider-codex-enabled
key.description: Whether to monitor Codex (ChatGPT backend usage via the local Codex CLI session)

key.name: provider-antigravity-enabled
key.description: Whether to monitor Google Antigravity via the agy CLI usage report

key.name: provider-copilot-enabled
key.description: Whether to monitor GitHub Copilot quota via the GitHub CLI session

key.name: provider-mistral-enabled
key.description: Whether to show Mistral (Firefox session fetch)

key.name: panel-provider
key.description: Which provider the panel percentage reflects: 'codex', 'antigravity', 'copilot' or 'mistral'

key.name: mistral-firefox-enabled
key.description: Opt-in: read the admin.mistral.ai session cookie from the Firefox profile to fetch the subscription page once per refresh. The cookie is used in memory only and never stored. Requires being signed in to admin.mistral.ai in Firefox

key.name: notify-on-reset
key.description: Raise a desktop notification when a monitored subscription quota resets (weekly or monthly windows), including resets that happen while the extension is not running

key.name: reset-notification-state
key.description: Internal JSON map of last-seen reset instants and notification markers per target; managed by the extension
